name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme that provides income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and domestic requirements.
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per annum, payable in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months directly transferred via DBT into bank accounts.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal landholding farmer families

required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked with mobile number
Land Ownership Documents (7/12 Extract / Khasra / Khatauni)
Active Bank Account Passbook (DBT / NPCI seeded)
application_process: Visit official portal pmkisan.gov.in or Common Service Centre (CSC).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter Aadhaar and Mobile number.
Fill landholding details and upload revenue records.
Complete eKYC via OTP or biometric authentication.

faqs.question: Are tenant farmers or agricultural laborers eligible?
faqs.answer: No, PM-KISAN requires cultivable landholding in the name of the farmer family as per official land records.

faqs.question: Is eKYC mandatory to receive the PM-KISAN installment?
faqs.answer: Yes, Aadhaar-based OTP eKYC or Biometric eKYC at CSC centers is mandatory for all registered farmers.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

native_names.hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)
native_names.mr: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NHA
description: AB-PMJAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, offering cashless secondary and tertiary hospital care coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for over 1,949 medical and surgical procedures across empanelled public and private hospitals.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Economically vulnerable, low-income, and SECC/BPL families

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Ration Card / BPL Card / SECC Household verification
application_process: Check eligibility at beneficiaries.nha.gov.in or download the Ayushman App.
Verify Aadhaar with OTP or visit any empanelled hospital Helpdesk (Ayushman Mitra).
Get e-KYC verified and generate your instant Ayushman Card.

faqs.question: What medical conditions and treatments are covered?
faqs.answer: Pre-existing conditions from Day 1, oncology, cardiology, neurosurgery, orthopedics, daycare treatments, medicine, and diagnostic expenses up to 15 days post-hospitalization.

faqs.question: Is there a family size or age limit for Ayushman Bharat?
faqs.answer: No, there is zero cap on family size or age. All eligible household members are covered under the single family floater.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Credit Linked Subsidy & Pucca House)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / MoRD
description: PMAY aims to achieve 'Housing for All' by providing pucca houses with basic amenities (water, electricity, toilet) to all eligible rural and urban homeless or kucha house dwellers.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh to ₹1.30 lakh in rural areas, and interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loans for urban EWS/LIG beneficiaries.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Homeless families or those living in kutcha/dilapidated homes

required_documents: Affidavit affirming no ownership of existing pucca house in India
application_process: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or via Gram Panchayat / Local Urban Body (ULB).
Submit applicant demographic details and Aadhaar number.
Geo-tagging and verification conducted by field inspectors.
Subsidy credited directly into bank account in milestone phases.

faqs.question: Can unmarried individuals apply for PMAY?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary family comprises husband, wife, and unmarried children. An adult earning member may be treated as a separate household provided they do not own a pucca house.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts
description: A government-backed small savings scheme backed by high interest rates, initiated under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign to secure the higher education and marriage funds for girl children.
benefits: Compound interest rate of 8.2% per annum, complete Triple Tax Exemption (EEE) under Section 80C, partial withdrawal allowed after age 18 for education.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Parents or legal guardians of girl child below 10 years of age

required_documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar Card & PAN Card of Parent / Guardian
Proof of Residence (Electricity bill, Passport, Ration card)
application_process: Visit any Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank branch.
Submit the filled Form SSA-1 with required documents.
Deposit initial minimum amount of ₹250 (up to ₹1.5 lakh per fiscal year).
Receive official Sukanya Passbook.

faqs.question: How many accounts can a family open?
faqs.answer: Maximum of 2 accounts per family (one for each girl child). Exception granted for twins or triplets.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro-enterprises to generate self-employment and business growth.
benefits: Zero collateral loans in three tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh) with affordable interest rates.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Micro entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, small manufacturing units

required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, Driving License)
Project proposal / Quotation of machinery to be purchased
application_process: Apply through the national portal udyamimitra.in or walk into any bank/NBFC.
Select loan tier (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun).
Submit loan proposal and KYC documents.
Loan sanctions processed within 7 to 15 business days.

faqs.question: Is collateral or third-party guarantee required for Mudra loans?
faqs.answer: No. Under RBI guidelines, banks cannot demand collateral security for PMMY loans.

faqs.question: What is the maximum loan limit under Mudra Yojana?
faqs.answer: Under PMMY, loans are categorized into Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 Lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 Lakh up to Rs 20 Lakh).

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: Comprehensive institutional support for traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools across 18 traditional trades.
benefits: Recognition via Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, Basic training stipend ₹500/day, ₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest rate.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Traditional artisans (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Sculptors, Cobblers, Tailors, Weavers)

application_process: Visit nearby Common Service Centre (CSC) for Aadhaar biometric verification.
Select primary traditional craft trade from 18 registered vocations.
Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verification.
Receive PM Vishwakarma digital ID card and skill voucher.

faqs.question: Which trades are covered under PM Vishwakarma?
faqs.answer: Carpenter, Boat Maker, Armourer, Blacksmith, Hammer & Tool Maker, Locksmith, Sculptor, Goldsmith, Potter, Cobbler, Mason, Basket/Mat/Broom maker, Doll/Toy maker, Barber, Garland maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net maker.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/EWS Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Tribal Affairs
description: Financial assistance to students belonging to socially disadvantaged and lower-income communities to pursue post-secondary and higher education.
benefits: Complete reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable college tuition fees plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹550/month for day scholars.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Students pursuing Class 11, Class 12, Diploma, UG, PG, or Ph.D. degrees

required_documents: Caste / Community Certificate issued by Competent Authority
application_process: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Provide OTR (One Time Registration) via Aadhaar e-KYC.
Select scheme under Social Justice or Tribal Affairs.
Upload documents and submit; verified by Institute Nodal Officer (INO).

faqs.question: Can I receive two scholarships simultaneously?
faqs.answer: No, a student can avail only one government scholarship benefit during a given academic year.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension scheme targeting unorganized sector workers to secure a dignified life in old age with defined monthly returns.
benefits: Government-guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after attaining 60 years of age, with spouse pension and nominee corpus return.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Citizens between 18-40 years working in unorganized sectors

required_documents: Active Savings Bank Account with auto-debit facility
application_process: Contact bank branch or post office where you hold a savings account.
Fill the APY subscriber registration form.
Authorize monthly auto-debit based on chosen pension slab.
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) card.

faqs.question: What happens if subscriber dies before 60?
faqs.answer: The spouse can either continue contributing for the remaining period or exit and claim the accumulated corpus.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

native_names.hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors to resume livelihoods.
benefits: Initial working capital loan of ₹10,000 with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment, escalating to ₹20,000 on 2nd tranche, and ₹50,000 on 3rd tranche, plus monthly digital transaction cashbacks.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Street vendors, hawkers, thelewala, cobblers, vegetable/tea sellers

required_documents: Certificate of Vending / ID Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC)
application_process: Access pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or Mobile App.
Check vending status with Urban Local Body.
Select Lending Institution (Bank/MFI) and submit loan application.
Disbursement direct to vendor bank account.

faqs.question: What is the penalty for early loan repayment?
faqs.answer: There is zero penalty or foreclosure charge for early repayment.

name: National Social Assistance Programme - IGNOAPS (Old Age Pension)

native_names.hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना (IGNOAPS)
native_names.mr: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धापकाळ निवृत्तीवेतन योजना

description: Direct social assistance pension provided to destitute elderly citizens living below the poverty line across India.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 (Central + State combined contribution depending on state) for beneficiaries aged 60 and above.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Destitute senior citizens aged 60+ belonging to BPL households

required_documents: BPL Card / Proof of destitute household status
Age proof (Birth Certificate, Voter ID, School Leaving)
application_process: Apply via Social Welfare Department, Tehsil Office, or nsap.nic.in.
Submit application with verification from Village Panchayat / Ward Councilor.
Pension sanctioned by District Collector / Social Welfare Officer.
Monthly DBT credited to savings account.

faqs.question: Does pension increase after age 80?
faqs.answer: Yes, for senior citizens aged 80 years and above, the central financial contribution increases from ₹200 to ₹500/month plus supplementary state allowance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides clean cooking LPG connections free of cost to adult women from poor and vulnerable households without existing gas connections.
benefits: Free LPG connection with security deposit exemption, free first cylinder refill, free hotplate (stove), and ₹300 direct targeted subsidy per cylinder refill for up to 12 refills/year.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Adult women belonging to BPL/SC/ST/Antyodaya households

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the woman applicant
Self-declaration for migrant families (no domicile proof needed)
application_process: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or directly visit local LPG distributor (Indane, BharatGas, HP).
Submit KYC form and Ration card details.
Connection issued within 7 days with safety demonstration.

faqs.question: Can migrant workers apply without local address proof in Ujjwala 2.0?
faqs.answer: Yes, Ujjwala 2.0 allows migrant workers to submit a self-declaration of address without requiring local domicile proofs.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) covering 85% of project cost up to ₹1 Crore with concessional interest rate and credit guarantee cover.

rules.target_beneficiaries: Women and SC/ST entrepreneurs starting manufacturing, services, or trading enterprises

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with cash-flow projections
Proof of Business premises / Lease agreement
application_process: Register on standupmitra.in portal.
Access handholding support from SIDBI/NABARD if needed.
Submit application to chosen commercial bank branch.
Loan appraisal and sanction within 3 to 6 weeks.

faqs.question: Can General category male entrepreneurs apply?
faqs.answer: For non-SC/ST enterprises, at least 51% shareholding and controlling stake must be held by a woman entrepreneur.
